title: This Amphibian Grows Nearly 6 Feet Long and Is Down 80%
subject: Chinese giant salamander

scenes.text: This amphibian can grow nearly six feet long.
It's the Chinese giant salamander, the largest amphibian on Earth.
Its eyes are tiny, so it hunts with sensors along its body that feel vibrations in the water.
It has no gills. It breathes through its skin, and folds along its sides add surface for oxygen.
Its wild numbers have dropped by about 80 percent in recent decades, and it is critically endangered.
A survey of 97 sites found them so rare that in many areas locals hadn't seen one in nearly 20 years.
